blind_target.evidence_quote: Our own inspection of the data reported by Burke et al. [3] converges to the conclusion that the robustness of these effect sizes may have been overestimated.
blind_target.outcome_computational_quote: Instead of analysing raw correlation coefficients, which are constrained to adopt values from −1 to +1 and do not follow a normal distribution, we converted all effect sizes to Fisher's z scores.
blind_target.outcome_robustness_quote: Consistent with the former interpretation, our own reanalysis of Burke et al. ([3]; see also [11]) provides compelling evidence that the effect sizes of previous research on mortality salience may have been overestimated.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Same meta-analytic data reanalysed using bias-sensitive alternatives; bias-corrected effect 37% smaller and original absence-of-bias conclusion challenged. Original-number reproduction was outside these alternative analyses.

luna_triage.reason: The paper reanalyses the same Burke et al. meta-analytic effect-size data and directly challenges the original conclusion that the distribution showed no bias.
